title: Agreeing by Chance — The Foot of Mount Phyle
description: Ben-Or's randomized consensus: four mercenaries, their ravens and a coin in each tent, and what chance buys that no plan can.
question: If no plan can guarantee agreement when a machine may stop without warning, can chance succeed where planning cannot? What if a machine that is stuck simply tosses a coin?
how: We find out by exploring how Greek mercenary camps, deadlocked over a plan, let a coin, tossed by each man alone in his tent, break the tie.

papers.title: Another Advantage of Free Choice: Completely Asynchronous Agreement Protocols
